task: If you move the ball, you must also take the key. Then pick up the box in the other room.

calls.candidate: hard Absence(key_lost), hard Existence(target_picked_up), hard Response(blocker_moved, has_door_key)
calls.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: two defects. (1) The clause Response(blocker_moved, has_door_key) uses the wrong template. The task says 'If you move the ball, you must also take the key' — the word 'also' means the key only needs to happen at some point, before or after moving the ball, so this should be a hard RespondedExistence(blocker_moved, has_door_key). The Response over-constrains the task by forbidding the valid course where the key is picked up before the ball is moved. (2) The hard Absence(key_lost) is an added requirement: no sentence of the task says the key must never be lost. Remove it.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: 'If you move the ball, you must also take the key' is correctly RespondedExistence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) hard ('also' allows before or after, and blocker_moved is only an 'if' condition, not a goal), and 'Then pick up the box' gives the hard Existence(target_picked_up), which forces completion through the key requirement in practice.
